points.description: Forms A − LC correctly: LC is the outer product [ℓ1;ℓ2][1 0] = [[ℓ1,0],[ℓ2,0]] (affecting only the first column), giving A−LC = [[−ℓ1, 1],[−ℓ2, −2]].
Correct desired polynomial for a double pole at −10: (s+10)² = s² + 20s + 100.
Matches coefficients to get ℓ1 = 18 and ℓ2 = 64 (L = [18; 64]). Both values required; follow-through not given if the polynomial from P2 was wrong.

rubric.notes: Four one-mark points, all-or-nothing each. Award P4 only when both ℓ1=18 and ℓ2=64 are correct. Equivalent methods (e.g. Ackermann's formula) that reach the same polynomial and gain earn the matching marks.
